_comment: Context for translators. Keys must match en.json. Tone: plain, short, no ERP jargon (design system README, Content).
appTeacher: App name shown under the logo and on the home screen. Keep the brand name OruSchools in Latin letters.
appStaff: App name for non-teaching staff (office, lab assistants, support).
appParent: App name for parents and students.
appPlatform: Name of the platform administration site (for the SaaS owner).
appWebsite: Title of the public website (browser tab). The tagline 'Schools. People. Progress.' is fixed brand copy: translate it only with approval (brand guidelines).
scaffoldNotice: Temporary placeholder text on unfinished screens. Not shown to schools in production.
greetingMorning: Home screen greeting before 12:00. {name} is the person's first name.
greetingAfternoon: Home screen greeting 12:00-17:00. {name} is the person's first name.
greetingEvening: Home screen greeting after 17:00. {name} is the person's first name.
actionUploadNow: Button that sends saved offline work immediately.
actionTakeAttendance: Primary button on the teacher home screen.
actionMarkAllPresent: Button that marks every student present; the teacher then changes only the exceptions.
actionSubmitAttendance: Primary button that submits the class attendance.
syncSynced: Sync status: all work is on the server.
syncSavedOnDevice: Sync status: work is saved on this phone and will upload when online.
syncChangesPending: Sync status: number of changes waiting to upload. Use the language's correct plural forms.
syncFailed: Sync status: the upload did not work.
statusLate: Attendance status: arrived after the bell.
statusMedical: Attendance status: absent for a medical reason.
statusHalfDay: Attendance status: present for half the day.
errorServerUnreachable: Error message. Reassures the user that nothing is lost; never blames them.
saasSignInTitle: Heading of the platform owner's sign-in screen.
saasSignInIntro: One line under the sign-in heading. Schools sign in elsewhere.
authEmailLabel: Label of the email field on sign-in.
authPasswordLabel: Label of the password field on sign-in.
actionSignIn: Button that signs a person in.
actionSignInGoogle: Button for Google sign-in. Keep the word Google in Latin letters.
actionSignInPhone: Link that switches sign-in to a one-time code sent by SMS.
actionSignInEmail: Link that switches sign-in back to email and password.
authPhoneLabel: Label of the phone number field.
authPhoneHint: Hint under the phone field. Keep the example number as it is.
actionSendCode: Button that sends a one-time code by SMS.
authCodeLabel: Label of the field where the SMS code is typed.
actionVerifyCode: Button that checks the SMS code.
authOr: Small word between two sign-in options.
actionSignOut: Button that signs the person out.
authSigningIn: Shown on the button while sign-in is in progress.
authErrorCredentials: Error after a wrong email or password. Do not say which one is wrong.
authErrorTooMany: Error when sign-in is temporarily blocked.
authErrorNetwork: Error when the device is offline during sign-in.
authErrorPopupClosed: Error when the person closes the Google sign-in window.
authErrorCode: Error after a wrong or expired SMS code.
authErrorPhone: Error for a phone number that is not valid.
saasNoAccessTitle: Heading shown to a signed-in person who is not the platform owner.
saasNoAccessBody: Explains the previous heading and what to do.
saasNavLabel: Screen reader name of the side navigation.
saasNavSchools: Side navigation item for the list of schools.
saasSchoolsCount: Number of schools under the heading.
saasSchoolsEmptyTitle: Empty state heading on the schools screen.
actionCreateSchool: Button that opens the create school form and submits it.
saasSchoolCreateTitle: Heading of the create school form.
saasSchoolName: Label of the school name field.
saasSchoolSubdomain: Label of the school's web address field (its subdomain).
saasSchoolSubdomainHint: Hint under the web address field. Keep the example as it is.
saasSchoolLanguage: Label of the school's default language choice.
actionEdit: Button that opens a form to change something.
saasSchoolEditTitle: Heading of the edit school form.
actionReactivate: Button that reactivates a suspended school.
saasSuspendTitle: Heading of the suspend confirmation. {name} is the school name.
saasSuspendReason: Label of the optional reason for suspending.
statusActive: Status of a school that is running.
statusSuspended: Status of a school that is suspended.
saasLoadFailed: Heading of the error when the list fails to load.
actionLoadMore: Button that loads the next page of a list.
errorAuthRequired: Error when the session has ended.
errorForbidden: Error when the action is not allowed.
errorNotFound: Error when something no longer exists.
errorInvalidRequest: Error when the server rejects the form.
errorConflict: Error when a name or web address is already taken.
errorRateLimited: Error when the person is sending requests too fast.
errorUpstream: Error when a back-end service is unavailable.
errorNetwork: Error when the device is offline.
errorTimeout: Error when a request times out.
statusLoading: Shown while a screen or list is loading.
actionAddAdmin: Button that adds the first administrator of a school.
saasAdminTitle: Heading of the form that adds a school's first administrator. {name} is the school name.
saasAdminIntro: Explains the add administrator form: the person sets their own password, and only the first administrator is added by the platform owner.
saasAdminName: Label of the administrator's name field.
saasAdminAdded: Confirmation after adding an administrator who signs in with email. {email} is their address.
saasAdminAddedNoEmail: Confirmation after adding an administrator who signs in by phone code only.
saasAdminEmailFailed: Warning when the account was created but the password email failed. Keep the quoted button name the same as the 'Forgot password?' text.
saasAdminExists: Error when the platform owner tries to add a second first-administrator.
errorAccountExists: Error when an email or phone number already has an account.
authForgot: Link on sign-in that sends an email to set a new password.
authResetSent: Shown after asking for a password email. Does not reveal whether the address has an account.
authResetNeedsEmail: Shown when 'Forgot password?' is pressed with the email field empty.
saasHasAdmin: Badge on a school that already has an administrator.
saasNoAdmin: Badge on a school that has no administrator yet, so nobody can sign in to it.
webSignInTitle: Heading of a school's sign-in screen. {name} is the school's name.
webSignInIntro: One line under the school sign-in heading.
webSchoolNotFoundTitle: Heading when the web address does not belong to an active school.
webNoSchoolTitle: Heading when the app is opened without a school's own web address.
webNoSchoolBody: Explains that people reach the app at their school's own address. Keep the example as it is.
webNoAccessTitle: Heading shown to a signed-in person who is not a member of this school. {name} is the school's name.
webNoAccessBody: Explains what to do about no access.
webLoadFailed: Heading of the error when the person's account details fail to load after sign-in.
webNavLabel: Screen reader name of the school's side navigation.
webComingTitle: Heading shown for a navigation item whose screen is not built yet.
webYourRole: Line on the dashboard that names the person's role in the school. {role} is the role name.
errorPageTitle: Heading of the page-level error screen.
actionTryAgain: Button that retries after an error.
sectionOverview: Heading of a group in the school's side navigation.
sectionAcademics: Heading of a group in the school's side navigation.
sectionPeople: Heading of a group in the school's side navigation.
sectionHr: Heading of a group in the school's side navigation.
sectionFinance: Heading of a group in the school's side navigation.
sectionCommunication: Heading of a group in the school's side navigation.
sectionTransport: Heading of a group in the school's side navigation.
sectionOperations: Heading of a group in the school's side navigation.
sectionReports: Heading of a group in the school's side navigation.
sectionAdministration: Heading of a group in the school's side navigation.
navDashboard: Item in the school's side navigation.
navStudents: Item in the school's side navigation.
navClasses: Item in the school's side navigation.
navAttendance: Item in the school's side navigation.
navGradebook: Item in the school's side navigation.
navSubstitution: Item in the school's side navigation.
navAdmissions: Item in the school's side navigation.
navStaff: Item in the school's side navigation.
navStaffAttendance: Item in the school's side navigation.
navLeave: Item in the school's side navigation.
navPayroll: Item in the school's side navigation.
navRecruitment: Item in the school's side navigation.
navFees: Item in the school's side navigation.
navAnnouncements: Item in the school's side navigation.
navTransport: Item in the school's side navigation.
navOperations: Item in the school's side navigation.
navReportsAcademic: Item in the school's side navigation.
navReportsFinance: Item in the school's side navigation.
navReportsHr: Item in the school's side navigation.
navSettings: Item in the school's side navigation.
navMemberships: Item in the school's side navigation.
navAudit: Item in the school's side navigation.
rolePrincipal: Name of a role a person has in a school.
roleManagement: Name of a role a person has in a school.
roleBursar: Name of a role a person has in a school.
roleAcademicAdmin: Name of a role a person has in a school.
roleSystemAdmin: Name of a role a person has in a school.
roleHrManager: Name of a role a person has in a school.
roleAccountant: Name of a role a person has in a school.
roleAdmissionsOfficer: Name of a role a person has in a school.
roleTransportManager: Name of a role a person has in a school.
roleOperationsManager: Name of a role a person has in a school.
roleTeacher: Name of a role a person has in a school.
roleStaff: Name of a role a person has in a school.
roleDriver: Name of a role a person has in a school.
roleParent: Name of a role a person has in a school.
errorUploadInvalid: Error when the chosen picture is not an accepted type or is too big.
errorUploadFailed: Error when sending a file to storage failed.
receiptTitle: Title at the top of a printed fee receipt.
receiptNumber: Label before the receipt number on a fee receipt.
receiptDate: Label before the date the fee was paid, on a fee receipt.
receiptStudent: Label before the student name on a fee receipt.
receiptEnrollment: Label before the student enrolment number on a fee receipt.
receiptClass: Label before the class (for example 5 B) on a fee receipt.
receiptFor: Label before what the payment was for (for example Tuition - April) on a fee receipt.
receiptAmountPaid: Label before the amount paid, on a fee receipt.
receiptMethod: Label before how the fee was paid (cash, cheque, UPI), on a fee receipt.
receiptReference: Label before the cheque, bank or UPI reference, on a fee receipt.
receiptBalance: Label before the amount still owed on the invoice after this payment, on a fee receipt.
receiptReceivedBy: Label before the name of the person who took the payment, on a fee receipt.
receiptCancelled: Large stamp across a fee receipt whose payment was reversed. Keep it short.
receiptFooter: Line at the bottom of a printed fee receipt.
paymentMethodCash: Way of paying a fee: cash.
paymentMethodCheque: Way of paying a fee: by cheque.
paymentMethodBankTransfer: Way of paying a fee: by bank transfer.
paymentMethodUpi: Way of paying a fee: by UPI (the Indian instant payment system).
paymentMethodOther: Way of paying a fee: any other way.
payslipTitle: Title at the top of a printed payslip.
payslipPeriod: Label before the month a payslip is for, for example 04/2027. (A month of pay, not a class period.)
payslipEmployee: Label before the name of the member of staff on a payslip.
payslipEmployeeId: Label before the employee number on a payslip.
payslipDepartment: Label before the department (for example Science) on a payslip.
payslipDesignation: Label before the job title (for example Teacher) on a payslip.
payslipEarnings: Heading of the list of pay components (basic pay, allowances) on a payslip.
payslipDeductions: Heading of the list of amounts taken off pay on a payslip.
payslipGross: Label before pay before deductions, on a payslip.
payslipTotalDeductions: Label before the sum of all deductions, on a payslip.
payslipNetPay: Label before the amount actually paid out, on a payslip. Keep it short.
payslipPaidOn: Label before the day the salary was paid, on a payslip.
payslipFooter: Line at the bottom of a printed payslip.
reportCollectionsTitle: Title of the printed fee collections report (money taken in a date range).
reportDuesTitle: Title of the printed report of unpaid fee invoices that have fallen due.
reportPayrollTitle: Title of the printed report of a year's approved and paid pay runs.
reportAsOf: Label before the date a report is calculated up to (for example As of 24-10-2026).
reportYear: Label before a calendar year on the payroll summary.
reportStatus: Column heading: the state of a payment or a pay run.
reportReversed: Status of a payment that was taken back.
reportTotal: Label of the last row, which adds up the columns above it.
notifLeaveRequestedTitle: Title of the notice to the Principal that a leave request is waiting.
notifLeaveRequestedBody: Body of the notice to the Principal: who asked for how many days of which kind of leave, and when.
notifLeaveApprovedTitle: Title of the notice to a member of staff that the Principal approved their leave.
notifLeaveApprovedBody: Body of the approval notice: the kind of leave, the dates and the number of days.
notifLeaveRejectedTitle: Title of the notice to a member of staff that the Principal did not approve their leave.
notifLeaveRejectedBody: Body of the notice that leave was not approved: the kind, the dates and the Principal's note, if any.
notifLeaveSubstitutionTitle: Title of the notice to the Academic administrator that approved leave leaves lessons uncovered.
notifLeaveSubstitutionBody: Body of that notice: who is away, when, and where to choose who covers.
notifLeavePayrollTitle: Title of the notice to HR that approved unpaid leave proposes a pay deduction.
notifLeavePayrollBody: Body of that notice: who, when, and where to review the proposed deduction.
notifSubstitutionAssignedTitle: Title of the notice to a teacher that they were chosen to cover another teacher's lesson.
notifSubstitutionAssignedBody: Body of that notice: which lesson, when, and for whom.
notifSubstitutionClearedTitle: Title of the notice to a teacher that a cover duty they were given was taken away.
notifSubstitutionClearedBody: Body of that notice: which lesson and when.
gradesReportCardTitle: Title of the printed report card of one student for one term.
gradesTerm: Label before the name of the school term on a printed report card.
gradesSubject: Column heading: the subject on a report card.
gradesMarks: Column heading: the marks a student got.
gradesOutOf: Column heading: the most marks that could be got.
gradesPercent: Column heading: marks as a percentage of the most possible.
gradesGrade: Column heading: the grade band the percentage falls in.
reportDueDate: Column heading: the date an invoice has to be paid by.
reportAmountDue: Column heading: the amount an invoice asks for.
reportOutstanding: Column heading: money still owed on an invoice.
reportDaysOverdue: Column heading: how many days past its due date an invoice is.
reportMonth: Column heading: the month a pay run is for.
reportHeadcount: Column heading: how many staff members were paid.
reportApproved: Status of a pay run the Principal has approved and the Bursar has not yet paid.
reportPaid: Status of a pay run that has been paid.
webFrom: Label of the first date of a date range on a report screen.
webTo: Label of the last date of a date range on a report screen.
webDownloadCsv: Button that saves the report as a spreadsheet file (CSV).
webDownloadPdf: Button that saves the report as a printable PDF file.
webDownloadFailed: Shown when saving a report file fails.
webAtAGlance: Heading of the row of key numbers on the dashboard.
webCollectedThisMonth: Dashboard number: fee money taken since the first of the month.
webPaymentsCount: How many payments make up a total.
webOutstandingFees: Dashboard number: fee money that has fallen due and is not paid.
webInvoicesCount: How many fee invoices make up a total.
webByMethod: Heading of the totals split by cash, cheque, UPI and so on.
webByAge: Heading of the outstanding totals split by how late they are.
webBandDueToday: Age group: falls due on the report date.
webNoRowsTitle: Empty state of a report for the chosen dates.
webNoRowsBody: Hint under the empty state of a report.
webNoDuesTitle: Empty state of the outstanding fees report: everything due is paid.
webTotalsOnly: Note shown to a role that may see report totals but not the people in them.
webPrevious: Button: go to the previous page of a table.
webNext: Button: go to the next page of a table.
webPageOf: Where you are in a table that has several pages.
webCollected: Label of the total of fee money taken in the chosen dates.
peoSearch: Placeholder-style label of the search box above a list of students.
peoAll: Choice that shows every status in a list.
peoInactive: Status of a student who is not attending at the moment.
peoLeft: Status of a student who has left the school.
peoAddStudent: Button that opens the form to add a student.
peoAddress: Form label for a home address.
peoClass: Heading of a column or form field: the class a student is in.
peoNoStudentsTitle: Empty state of the students list.
peoNoStudentsBody: Hint under the empty state of the students list.
peoNoMatch: Shown when a search finds nothing.
peoGuardians: Heading of the list of a student's guardians.
peoNoGuardians: Shown when a student has no guardian on record.
peoRelationship: Form label: how a guardian is related to the child.
peoGuardianRel: Relationship choice: a guardian who is not a parent.
peoPrimary: Marks the guardian the school calls first.
peoClassHistory: Heading of the list of classes a student has been in.
peoAdmissionDate: Label of the day a student was admitted.
peoBackToList: Link back from a detail page to its list.
peoCapacity: Column heading: how many students a class can hold.
peoSection: Column heading: the section letter of a class.
peoLevel: Column heading: the class level, for example 5 or Nursery.
peoNoClassesTitle: Empty state of the classes list.
peoApplications: Title of the admissions applications screen.
peoNewApplication: Button that opens the form for a new admission application.
peoApplicationNo: Column heading: the number given to an application.
peoLevelApplied: Form label: the class level the child is applying to.
peoSubmitted: Status of an application that has just come in.
peoUnderReview: Status of an application being looked at.
peoAccepted: Status of an application the school has accepted.
peoRejected: Status of an application the school has turned down.
peoWithdrawn: Status of an application the family took back.
peoAdmitted: Status of an application whose child is now a student.
peoStartReview: Button: move an application to under review.
peoWithdraw: Button: record that the family withdrew the application.
peoNote: Form label for a note that goes with a decision.
peoAdmitStudent: Button: turn an accepted application into a student.
peoStudentAdmitted: Confirmation after admitting a student; {id} is the new enrolment number.
peoNoApplicationsTitle: Empty state of the applications list.
hrpAddStaff: Button that opens the form to add a staff member.
hrpSearch: Label of the search box above the staff list.
hrpAllDepartments: Choice that shows staff of every department.
hrpJoined: Label of the day a staff member joined.
hrpNoStaffTitle: Empty state of the staff list.
hrpNoMatch: Shown when a search finds nothing.
hrpStaffAdded: Confirmation after adding a staff member.
hrpSalary: Heading of the salary section on a staff member's page.
hrpEarning: Kind of salary line: money the person is paid.
hrpDeduction: Kind of salary line: money taken off pay.
hrpComponent: Form label: the name of a salary line, for example Basic pay.
hrpAmount: Column heading and form label for an amount of money.
hrpAddLine: Button that adds a line to a salary.
hrpNoLines: Shown when a staff member has no salary lines.
hrpRemove: Button that removes a salary line.
hrpNewRun: Button that starts the monthly pay run.
hrpRunCreated: Confirmation after creating a pay run.
hrpDraft: Status of a pay run that can still change.
hrpPreparedBy: Label: who made the pay run.
hrpApprovedBy: Label: who approved the pay run.
hrpApprove: Button: the Principal approves a pay run.
hrpPay: Button: the Bursar records that a pay run was paid.
hrpDeleteRun: Button that deletes a draft pay run.
hrpConfirm: Button that confirms an action that cannot be undone.
hrpConfirmApprove: Question before a pay run is approved.
hrpConfirmPay: Question before a pay run is marked as paid.
hrpConfirmDelete: Question before a draft pay run is deleted.
hrpRunTitle: Title of one month's pay run page.
hrpDetails: Opens the lines of one payslip.
hrpPayslipPdf: Button that saves one payslip as a PDF.
hrpNoRunsTitle: Empty state of the pay runs list.
hrpNoRunsBody: Hint under the empty state of the pay runs list.
feeTabInvoices: Tab: the list of fee invoices.
feeTabReceipts: Tab: the list of fee receipts.
feeTabStructures: Tab: what each class level pays.
feeStatusOverdue: Status of an invoice past its due date and not paid.
feeStatusPartial: Status of an invoice that has been paid in part.
feeStatusPending: Status of an invoice that has no payment yet.
feeBilled: Total of the invoices in a list.
feeNewInvoice: Button that opens the form for a one-off invoice.
feeBillFees: Button that opens the form that makes invoices from the fee structures.
feeDescription: Form label: what an invoice is for.
feeFindStudent: Label of the box that finds the student an invoice is for.
feeRecordPayment: Button that records money received for an invoice.
feePaymentRecorded: Confirmation after a payment; {number} is the receipt number.
feePayments: Heading of the payments made against an invoice.
feeNoPayments: Shown when an invoice has no payment.
feeMethod: Form label: cash, cheque, UPI and so on.
feeReverse: Button that takes a payment back.
feeReason: Form label: why a payment is being reversed.
feeConfirmReverse: Question before a payment is reversed.
feeReceiptPdf: Button that saves a receipt as a PDF.
feeBillUpTo: Form label: the last due date to bill.
feePreview: Button that counts what would be billed without saving anything.
feeCreateInvoices: Button that makes the invoices after a preview.
feePreviewResult: Result of a preview of billing.
feeLevelAll: Choice that bills every class level.
feeReceiptsTotal: Total of the receipts in a list.
feeNoReceiptsTitle: Empty state of the receipts list.
feeNoInvoicesTitle: Empty state of the invoices list.
feeNoInvoicesBody: Hint under the empty state of the invoices list.
feeNewStructure: Button that starts the fee structure of a class level.
feeStructureCreated: Confirmation after creating a fee structure.
feeAddFee: Button that adds a fee, for example Tuition, to a structure.
feeFeeName: Form label: the name of a fee, for example Tuition.
feeInstalments: Heading of the parts a fee is paid in.
feeInstalmentLabel: Form label: the name of an instalment, for example Term 1.
feeAddInstalment: Button that adds a row for another instalment.
feeNoStructuresTitle: Empty state of the fee structures list.
feeStructureTotal: Total of all the fees of a structure.
feeNoItems: Shown when a structure has no fees.
setTabClasses: Tab: the classes of the school.
setAddClass: Button that opens the form for a new class.
setSubjectCode: Form label: a short unique code of a subject, for example MATH.
setNoSubjects: Empty state of the subjects list.
setNewYear: Button that opens the form for a new academic year.
setYearName: Hint for the name of an academic year.
setMakeActive: Button that makes an academic year the active one.
setConfirmActivate: Question before an academic year becomes the active one.
setYearAdded: Confirmation after adding an academic year.
setProfileTitle: Heading of the school profile form.
setBrandColour: Form label: the school's main colour.
setBrandHint: Hint under the brand colour field.
setProfileSaved: Confirmation after saving the school profile.
setImport: Button that opens the CSV import.
setCheckFile: Button that checks a CSV file without saving anything.
setCheckResult: Result of checking a CSV file.
setMissingColumns: Lists the columns a CSV file must have and does not.
setProblemLine: One problem found in a CSV file.
setAlreadyImported: Shown when the same CSV file is chosen again.
setImportNow: Button that imports a checked CSV file.
setImportFailed: Result after a CSV import when some rows failed.
hrrByDepartment: Heading of the payroll totals split by department.
hrrNoDepartment: Label for staff who have no department.
hrrNoRunsTitle: Empty state of the payroll summary.
webApplicationsWaiting: Dashboard number: admission applications that have come in and nobody has started to review.
webRunsWaiting: Dashboard number: draft pay runs the Principal has not approved yet.
webFieldRoleTitle: Heading shown on the web ERP to a person whose role is for the mobile apps (teacher, staff, driver, parent).
webFieldRoleBody: Explains where a mobile-app role should go. Keep the brand name OruSchools in Latin letters.
usrTabMembers: Tab: the people who can sign in to this school.
usrTabInvitations: Tab: the invitations that have been made.
usrSince: Column heading: when a person joined the school.
usrYou: Marks the row that is the signed-in person.
usrChangeRole: Button that changes the role of a member.
usrRole: Column heading and form label: the role a person has.
usrConfirmRole: Question before a member's role is changed.
usrConfirmSuspend: Question before a member is suspended.
usrConfirmRemove: Question before a member is removed.
usrNewAccount: Button that opens the form that creates an account for a staff member.
usrAccountIntro: Explains who an account is for.
usrLinkSent: Shown after the set-password email was sent.
usrLinkFailed: Shown when the set-password email could not be sent.
usrSendLink: Button that sends the set-password email again.
usrNewInvitation: Button that opens the form for an invitation.
usrExpiresIn: Form label: how many days an invitation can be used.
usrInvitationCode: Shown with a new invitation's secret code.
usrRevoke: Button that cancels an invitation that has not been used.
usrExpires: Column heading: when an invitation stops working.
usrPending: Status of an invitation nobody has used yet.
usrCancelled: Status of an invitation that was cancelled.
usrNoInvitations: Empty state of the invitations list.
usrHaveCode: Opens the box where a person enters the invitation code they were given.
usrEnterCode: Label of the invitation code field.
usrJoin: Button that uses an invitation code.
usrJoined: Confirmation after a person used an invitation code.
errorInvitationInvalid: Error: an invitation code was refused.
errorEmailNotVerified: Error: the person has not verified their email address.
errorOwnMembership: Error: someone tried to change their own role.
